title: Sodium Thiosulphate
notes: **Uses:** photographic fixer (dissolves unexposed AgBr: $AgBr + 2Na_2S_2O_3 \rightarrow Na_3[Ag(S_2O_3)_2] + NaBr$), antiseptic (antichlor in textile bleaching), analytical reagent (iodometric titrations).
**Reaction with iodine:** $2Na_2S_2O_3 + I_2 \rightarrow Na_2S_4O_6 + 2NaI$. Used in iodometric titrations to determine oxidising agents.
**Antichlor action:** removes excess chlorine from bleached fabrics: $Na_2S_2O_3 + 4Cl_2 + 5H_2O \rightarrow 2NaCl + 2H_2SO_4 + 6HCl$.
